en.headline: Blue Lock Egoist exhibition continues at AIRSIDE in Kai Tak
en.dek: The first overseas stop of the official anime exhibition runs daily until 24 November at the Kai Tak venue, with life-size displays and original artwork.
body: The Blue Lock Egoist Exhibition the animation has been open at AIRSIDE in Kai Tak since 6 November and continues through 24 November.
Organisers said the show is the first overseas stop of the Japanese exhibition, featuring original animation drawings, character displays, recreations of scenes and a pop-up store.
The venue is open daily from 11:00 to 21:00, with last admission at 20:00. Ticket prices start at HK$98 for a single adult admission, according to the organisers.
Visitors can see a 1:1 recreation of the Team Z locker room and other themed areas on different floors of the building.

zh.headline: 藍色監獄Egoist展繼續於啟德AIRSIDE舉行
zh.dek: 官方動畫展海外首站即日起至11月24日於啟德場地每日開放，設有等身展示及原畫。
body: 《藍色監獄展 EGOIST EXHIBITION the animation》自11月6日起於啟德AIRSIDE開幕，展期至11月24日。
主辦單位表示，這是日本展覽的海外首站，展出動畫原畫、角色展示、經典場景重現及限定商店。
場地每日上午11時至晚上9時開放，最後入場時間為晚上8時。主辦單位指，單人成人門票由98元起。
觀眾可在大樓不同樓層參觀1:1還原的Z隊更衣室及其他主題區域。
